__comment: Playbook §6.9. String value = keep verbatim. Object value = pinned per-locale translation. Enforced twice: in the model prompt AND by a deterministic post-pass, so a controlled term can never drift.
__comment_compliance: US federal contracting identifiers and program names are NEVER translated (playbook §2, domain 3). They are legal identifiers, not prose. There is no Italian regulator vocabulary for them — the authority is the US program itself, so the English term is the official term.
Making Businesses Stronger. Making Life: Making Businesses Stronger. Making Life Better.
